pins.line_prefix: | JL and JR to K, 19.0 mm | Harwin R30-1011902

pins.object: derived: nets of pins 1 and 3 of every PTV09A-4020F
pins.reads: the nets at the two end pins of every panel pot

provenance.pin_rule: SHA256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) of the object read, or of the exact row or line text

ledger_other_cases_mA.source: pins ledger-conditional_SH_short_resistor_case_mA, ledger-sensitivity_case_mA, ledger-conditional_startup_1ms_mA; feed A plus feed B

plan_heat_W.source: pin plan-heat-row: the two figures of the row read by their unit W (normal planning load, supply contract)

bleeder_residual.source: identified as two inlet bleeders of 5.730028/5.679522/2.387511 mA by pin ledger-bleeder-line

inlet_board.source: no inlet position exists (#57); K is the conditional load-side power star of partition-boards

contract_distribution.source: the contract is a source requirement with no location; its excess over the planning load is spread over the planning map rail by rail

value: label names the IC symbol: split by the boards of that instance's packages of that symbol
REF5050 rows and the S&H reference allowance: boards of the instance's REF5050AIDR packages
S&H logic allowance: boards of the instance's SN74HC14DR and CD74HC221M96 packages
inlet leakage allowances and the bleeder residual: inlet_board
LED rows: board of the instance's L: uids of that kind (mag, clip, stage); driver and resistor dissipation taken with the LED
output-load rows: count x V^2/R leaves the instrument; the rest is taken on the instance's jack board (output stage location; K is the alternative)
panel-pot and manual-track rows: P, by the partition rule that all pots are on P
enable feeds: boards of the instance's TMUX7412FRRPR packages, else K
comparator pull-ups: boards of the instance's LM393BIDR packages
every other row (reserves, bias, clamps, feedback, trims, dividers): K, by the partition rule core -> K
row_rules.source: partition-assignment rule text and the row labels; only IC, NOISE2, REF and LOGIC are bound to packages

sub_logic_load.source: SUB divider and gating on +5 V are not in the ledger; ST-11 refreshes it (plan page, ledger follow-up 2)

octave_receiver_reduction.source: 30 to 18 octave receivers (plan page SI-5); not credited, so the map stays conservative

led_state.source: pin ledger-external-load-line: on-state LED terms are already in the rows

post_joint_ohm.source: pin plan-joint-line (planning requirement, not a part figure)

link_ground_current_A.source: pin decision-DS-62 (at most, one post open)

supply_efficiency.source: no source is selected and no efficiency is retained (Q6, #57); the range spans a switching stage with or without linear post-regulation

wall_mm.source: no enclosure drawing is retained; side and rear wall thickness added outside the internal box

h_conv_vertical.source: laminar natural convection of a 0.3 m vertical face at 10 to 25 K rise; textbook order, no retained document

h_conv_up.source: heated face facing up; textbook order, no retained document

h_conv_resting.source: the face that rests on a table or shelf carries no heat (conservative); radiation from it is also dropped

eps_case.source: painted or anodised outer finish; no enclosure finish is selected

eps_bare_metal.source: sensitivity row for a bare metal finish inside and out

eps_board.source: solder mask; no board finish emissivity is retained

eps_inner.source: inner case finish equal to the outer one; the bare-metal row covers an untreated inside

sigma.source: Stefan-Boltzmann constant (CODATA); physical constant, no repository document

air.source: dry air near 50 degC; textbook property values, no retained document

gap_nu_low.source: conduction only: the lower bound of every gap; no obstruction can drive the gap below it except by displacing air with a poorer conductor

gap_nu_vertical.source: enclosed vertical layer heated from the side (Catton form, Nu = C (Pr/(0.2+Pr) Ra)^n (H/L)^-1/4, floor 1); textbook, not retained, extrapolated outside 2 < H/L < 10

gap_nu_heated_below.source: horizontal layer heated from below (Globe-Dropkin form, floor 1 below Ra 1708); a layer heated from above stays at Nu 1; textbook, not retained

h_spread_cu.source: in-plane spreading of K: copper conductivity, 35 um per oz and the copper fraction per layer are not retained; layers and copper weight are SOURCED from pin partition-boards

cell_mm.source: Amendment 2 of the brief: region resolution about 50 mm

move_mm.source: pins decision-DS-74 and decision-DS-88 (re-placement radius 25 mm; 12 mm for most)

non_ic_k_location.source: non-IC K rows of a module are placed at the centroid of that module's K footprints; inlet rows are spread over K

link_figures.source: pin link-gate-figures: links, placed and slots from the summary of the gate record; slot area from the slot rectangles, loop and cable areas from loop_mm and cable_length_mm times the tail width of each placed link

place_source.source: pins link-gate-displaced-k-ic-packages and floorplan-placements: the new place of every package listed in displaced_k_ic_packages (DS-97, the interface of the a2 scope), the floorplan place of every other; the floorplan alone while the key is absent

hot_package_W.source: pin decision-DS-98: the hot set is every package of 100 mW or more; the threshold is ASSUMED by the ruling

hot_within_mm.source: pin decision-DS-98 (point 7 of the a2 scope): count and watts of hot packages within 25 mm of each sensitive site

hot_region_fraction.source: the warm region of K is the bounding box of the cells whose lateral rise is at least this fraction of the hottest cell; a reporting rule, not a physical limit

vent_area_cm2.source: per vent, one low and one high; no vent exists or is designed

vent_cd.source: discharge coefficient of a sharp slot; textbook

vent_height_m.source: height between inlet and outlet: across the panel height standing, across the depth lying

post_af_mm.source: pin posts-r30-row (A/F 5.30 to 5.50 mm, brass CW614N)

post_bore_mm.source: M3 through-tap; minor diameter not retained

sleeve_count.source: pin fixings-active (kind sleeve added); printed plastic, conduction not credited

bleeder_rth_K_per_W.source: pin fact-power-bleeder-application: the bundle's own generic mounting estimate (a project estimate, not a maker figure)

hc_logic_ambient_max_C.source: pins fact-schmitt-temperature and fact-flipflop-temperature (SN74HC14DR, SN74HC74DR recommended free-air range)

as3340_vee_V.source: pin osc-vee-line (VEE driver fed by -5 V reference; core VEE current charged to -12 V)

as3340_icc_mA.source: pin fact-vco-positive-supply-current (max column of a typical table at 15 V, 20 degC)

magnitude_led_mA_per_rail.source: ledger magnitude rows: 3.75 mA per 3 LEDs on each rail

soak_proposal.value: 2 h and until every sensor changes by less than 0.5 K in 30 min
soak_proposal.source: proposal for #64; no retained test standard

h_conv_feet.source: pin decision-DS-96: the resting face of a case on feet carries 4 to 8 W/m2K in place of nothing; radiation from it is still dropped

amplifiers_per_package.source: pin ledger-worksheet-loads: quiescent_condition of the OPA4196IDR and OPA4197 rows ("four channels per package")

low_heat_typicals.source: pins fact-op-precision-d-quiescent-current, fact-op-precision-quiescent-current, fact-op-audio-quiescent-current and fact-fault-switch-t-normal-supply-current; pin decision-DS-95: the low-heat load takes the typical quiescent current at 25 degC of each part whose bundle holds one, row by row of the ledger, where a row holds count x the bundle maximum named in ledger_basis_keys (checked), and lowers the two-feed total by the same current. Not taken: AS3340D, whose typical table is at TA = 20 degC and VCC = +15 V (pin fact-vco-positive-supply-current); every other part, whose bundle holds no typical supply current at 25 degC

verdict_rule.value: board at the part against the limit of the exact part
verdict_rule.source: pin decision-DS-95: MET ON PAPER when the worst end (planning load, low coefficients) is at or below the limit, EXCEEDED ON PAPER when the best end (low-heat load, high coefficients) is above it, NOT SHOWN otherwise and wherever no limit is retained; the headline takes the worse orientation

ds96_bleeder_region_mm.source: pin decision-DS-96: the bleeder note names a place outside x 0 to 100, y 150 to 250 of K

sensor_within_mm.source: pin decision-DS-95: the proposal for #64 puts a sensor on the body of the part or on the board within 3 mm of it

thermal_survey_not_figures.source: pin fact-fault-switch-t-thermal-pad: the TMUX7412FRRPR pad fact ties the exposed pad to a net and holds no thermal resistance, junction limit or range

ground_nets.source: the ground nets of the netlist are the 0 V reference of the rails of pin ledger-case-envelope; no other net of the control netlist holds a retained voltage

pot_resistance_tolerance.source: pins fact-b103-resistance, fact-b104-resistance and fact-b504-resistance: standard resistance tolerance of +/-20 %; the power of a pot is taken over the resistance less 20 % (DS-103)

plan_compare_decimals.source: the plan figures are compared with the screen at the printed decimals of the row or at this many, whichever is finer, so that a figure printed as 35 W cannot read as reproducing 35.41 W

ambient_search_C.source: search interval of the ambient at which a class reads its limit; the network is run at each trial ambient (DS-106 point 7)

stack_share_K.source: pins decision-DS-94 and decision-DS-106: a shift of the 40 mm stack against the 120 mm case above 5 K at either end is marked "share of the 40 mm stack"

fact-srbv-operating-temperature.value: The retained SRBV series catalogue (Update 2510) prints no operating or storage temperature for SRBV160803; its Note 1 says it shows only outline specifications.

stage_white.verdict: CONDITIONAL: assumed +5 V <=5.5 V; manufacturer graph near 5 mA at 85 C; exact resistor derating, supply tolerance, fault response and light output open

magnitude_white.verdict: CONDITIONAL: assumed +/-12 V rails <= +/-13.2 V; magnitude fault/loop behavior, exact resistor sourcing and installed ambient remain open

clip_red.verdict: CONDITIONAL: assumed +/-12 V rails <= +/-13.2 V; exact resistor/fault response open

fact-power-bleeder-application.value: Conditional85C calculation lies below the series power curve, but generic400K/W mounting estimate exceeds advised110C solder-joint temperature on the analog rails. Installed thermal suitability remains open.

fact-vco-supply-guidance.value: The datasheet describes an on-chip 7.4 V Zener; for VEE values above -7.5 V it requires a series current-limiting resistor, and it recommends external VEE = -5 V to reduce self-heating.

fact-fault-switch-t-thermal-pad.value: Thermal pad not connected internally; GND or VSS recommended. Project ties pad 17 to AGND.

fact-kingbright-white-identity.value: Kingbright APHHS1005QWF/D; 0402 top emitter; 0.5 mm package height
